note: Derived caption inputs for the third Notes line. Every number is copied verbatim (as text) from an existing saved output table; nothing is re-estimated. Stars (internal convention, documented here and in the README, not printed on the charts): * p<0.10, ** p<0.05, *** p<0.01 from the saved p. Percentages are formatted from these full-precision rows. Enrollment estimates are pooled static DiD estimates, NOT arithmetic means of the dynamic event-study coefficients.

enrollment_pooled.unit: enrolled vulnerable (NESE-B, Infantil) pupils per pupil needed to reach the quota (unit of treat_nb)
enrollment_pooled.model: Existing pooled static continuous DiD (fit_static / fit_static_cstat_up in <Dropbox>/Pla de Xoc/Data/Temp/fixes_04_06_20260922/before/code/06_JP_continuous_did.R): outcome on treat_nb x post, school and year fixed effects, weights n_students, SE clustered by school; sample 2013-2024, post = 2019-2024 (quota year 2019). Not re-estimated.

percent_of_initial_quota_gap.meaning: Scales the estimated response to the initial quota gap. Dose D = corrected reserved-seat quota minus baseline 2016-2018 mean vulnerable enrollment; est is pupils per pupil of D, so est * D / D = est. Not a percent change in enrollment (never est / pre_mean), not observed quota closure.

enrollment_by_type.unit: enrolled vulnerable (NESE-B, Infantil) pupils per pupil needed to reach the quota (unit of treat_nb)
enrollment_by_type.model: Existing pooled static continuous DiD (fit_static / fit_static_cstat_up in <Dropbox>/Pla de Xoc/Data/Temp/fixes_04_06_20260922/before/code/06_JP_continuous_did.R): outcome on treat_nb x post, school and year fixed effects, weights n_students, SE clustered by school; sample 2013-2024, post = 2019-2024 (quota year 2019). Not re-estimated.

percent_of_initial_quota_gap.meaning: Scales the estimated response to the initial quota gap. Dose D = corrected reserved-seat quota minus baseline 2016-2018 mean vulnerable enrollment; est is pupils per pupil of D, so est * D / D = est. Not a percent change in enrollment (never est / pre_mean), not observed quota closure.

crime.quantity: Callaway-Sant'Anna (never-treated) post-adoption average ATT on the youth (16-25) minus adult (36-45) crime-rate gap, crimes per 1,000
crime.consistency: Rounds to the unchanged data/crime_gap_aggregate.json (-17.061, 6.697, 0.011; provenance.json crime_gap_agg). Stars from the exact p in this row.

denominator.formula: mean_gap = 100 * mfx / pct_of_mean (identical in all six rows within 1e-10); percent = 100 * abs(row.est) / mean_gap
denominator.meaning: DESCRIPTIVE full input panel mean of the youth-adult crime-rate gap (per 1,000), weighted by w_unit: historical producer 5_Package/1_Codes/3_Analysis/19_ddd_grid/03_nonlinearity_ddd.R computes gap_mean <- weighted.mean(d$gap, d$w_unit, na.rm = TRUE) and pct_of_mean = 100 * mfx / gap_mean. The main DiD (02) and the nonlinearity script (03) build the same input panel (build_gap_panel2(16, 25, 36, 45), deduplicated populations, weights w_unit; 2008-2017, 326 tracts, 3192 rows, 186 adopters; logs match the main ATT). Only the shared INPUT panel is verified; did may drop unbalanced units internally, so this is NOT the exact internal estimation-sample mean, and NOT a control, untreated or pre-period mean. The percentage is a descriptive scale benchmark, not a causal percent decline.
denominator.numerator_note: The numerator is the main ATT (row.est), never a nonlinear mfx.

wage.stars_from: csdid_p (unadjusted p, as used for the stars on the original plot)

percent_of_control_mean.meaning: ATT relative to the saved control mean ctrl_mean (EUR per month)

original_printed.note: Consistency anchor: csdid and csdid_se round to the printed ATT/SE (3 decimals). The event-study graph itself stays a graphical reconstruction of this raster.

wage.unit: EUR per month, male graduates, after the first offer
